create_LARS_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer instance with custom learning rate, weight decay, momentum, and trust coefficient for PyTorch model training
run_LARS_step: run a single optimization step with the LARS optimizer to update model parameters using adaptive local learning rates
configure_LARS_trust_coefficient: configure the LARS optimizer trust coefficient to control the adaptive scaling ratio between parameter norm and update norm
review_LARS_weight_decay: review the LARS optimizer step method to understand how weight decay is applied only to parameters with more than 1 dimension
summarize_LARS_momentum: summarize the LARS optimizer momentum implementation that maintains a moving average of updates stored in the optimizer state
